articles.title: Blinkit crosses 1,000 dark stores milestone across India
articles.summary: Blinkit, the Zomato-owned quick commerce platform, has crossed the 1,000 dark store mark, cementing its lead in the hyperlocal grocery delivery segment.

articles.title: Swiggy Instamart doubles down on private label strategy amid margin pressure
articles.summary: Swiggy Instamart is expanding its private label portfolio to improve unit economics as the quick commerce battle intensifies across metro cities.

articles.title: Zepto raises fresh capital to accelerate dark store expansion in Tier 2 cities
articles.summary: Zepto is deploying capital into Tier 2 city expansion, with new dark stores planned in Jaipur, Lucknow, and Indore over the next two quarters.

articles.title: Meesho overtakes Flipkart in monthly active users; hits 150 million mark
articles.summary: Meesho has overtaken Flipkart in monthly active users for the first time, driven by its value-first strategy and deep penetration in non-metro markets.

articles.title: HUL reports strong QCom contribution as quick commerce now 8% of overall ecommerce revenue
articles.summary: Hindustan Unilever's quick commerce channel contribution has surged, with platforms like Blinkit and Zepto now accounting for nearly 8% of the company's total ecommerce revenue.

articles.title: Retail media ad spend in India expected to cross ₹4,000 crore in FY26
articles.summary: India's retail media market is on an exponential growth curve, with brands allocating larger slices of digital budgets to in-platform advertising on Flipkart, Blinkit, and Amazon.
